steps.body: Swapping is safe because addition only joins groups. The pile of counters does not know which group was named first.
steps.narration: Swapping is safe because addition only joins groups. The pile of counters does not know which group was named first.

widget.prompt: Check the swap: start at 9 and count on 4 for 4 + 9. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 9 and count on 4: you land on 13.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 13 — the same 13 that 4 + 9 makes, because the same groups joined.

predict.reveal: The same two groups are in the pile, so the total is the same 13.

options.label: 7 — the same total
options.feedback: Correct — swapping the order of the addends never changes the total; both give 7.

options.label: 8 — one more
options.feedback: Nothing was added when the order swapped, so the total cannot grow to 8.

options.feedback: Nothing was removed when the order swapped, so the total cannot shrink to 6.

options.label: 1 — the difference
options.feedback: The difference compares the addends; swapping them is still addition and keeps the total 7.
